words.def: the work and cost of keeping something in good condition.
words.book: I'm in charge of managing the creation and release of new products, as well as the improvement and upkeep of the ones we already have.
uses: Email
The quotation covers installation and one year of upkeep for the solar system.
Chat
who's handling the upkeep of the gen sets at the branch?
Meeting
Upkeep costs for old lead-acid batteries are higher than lithium over five years.
dont: The keeping of the machines costs a lot.
doo: The upkeep of the machines is expensive.

words.def: involving people from different departments working together.
words.book: I spend a lot of time meeting with cross-functional teams to discuss new product ideas and gather feedback.
uses: Email
I've set up a cross-functional meeting with sales, service and accounts to review overdue invoices.
Chat
cross-functional call at 2 — sales + tech + purchasing
Meeting
This data-centre project needs a cross-functional team from day one.
dont: A team from all the departments mixed.

words.def: to give part of your work or responsibility to someone else.
words.book: I've also been trying to delegate tasks more effectively, to make sure I don't take on too much at once.
uses: Email
I have delegated the site survey to Karim, who will send you the report by Monday.
Chat
can't do the visit today, i'll delegate it to Hany
Meeting
As a team leader, you need to delegate the routine PM visits.
dont: I will give the work to another one.
doo: I'll delegate it to a colleague.

words.def: to find the cause of a technical problem and fix it.
words.book: I also worked closely with the engineering team to troubleshoot any issues that arose, and with the marketing team to develop the go-to-market strategy.
uses: Email
Our engineer will visit tomorrow to troubleshoot the UPS alarm on site.
Chat
troubleshooting the VFD now, looks like an overcurrent fault ⚡
Meeting
Can we troubleshoot remotely before we send a technician?
dont: The engineer will search about the problem.
doo: The engineer will troubleshoot the problem.

words.def: acting early to prevent problems instead of waiting for them to happen.
words.book: I always try to be proactive and think creatively about how we can improve our products and processes.
uses: Email
To be proactive, we recommend replacing the batteries before the summer peak.
Chat
love how proactive the service team was with that client 👏
Meeting
We need a more proactive approach to collections, not just chasing late payments.
dont: I do the things before somebody tells me.

words.def: to check that two sets of financial records match and agree.
words.book: My main responsibilities include preparing and analyzing financial statements, reconciling accounts, and managing and reporting on the company's financial performance.
uses: Email
Could you send your statement of account so we can reconcile it with our records?
Chat
still reconciling the client's payments, numbers don't match yet 🙈
Meeting
We reconcile supplier accounts at the end of every month.
dont: We will match the account with the customer.
doo: We will reconcile the account with the customer.
